claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's entire mechanical payload is making a touched object shed Bright Light in a radius and Dim Light in a further radius. This has real mechanical consequences (visibility, hiding, Perception checks, etc.) but no atom in v4 or types.ts models light emission from an object. It is distinct from grant_sense (which gives a creature a sense) and from any existing effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.caster_recasts_this_spell
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell ends early if the caster casts Light again (one-at-a-time constraint). The existing DurationEndTrigger variants cover target-side events; there is no variant for 'caster recasts this same spell', which is a distinct SRD pattern appearing on several cantrips.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends if you cast it again.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ObjectFilter.maxSize
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell restricts valid targets to Large or smaller objects. ObjectFilter has no size field, so this targeting constraint is unrepresentable in the current surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else.
